pages.text: The $(item)Fire Alarm Pull Station$() goes on a wall, touching a $(l:radiocraft:alarms/fire_alarm_box)fire alarm box$(/l) or on its data wire. Right click to pull it: the bar comes down and the box sends the alarm. It stays pulled until reset.$(br2)Sneak and right click to see its location number, name and alarm type without pulling it.

The $(item)Fire Alarm Key$() resets a pulled station or panic button: use it on one and the box sends RESTORE. It also opens a fire alarm box for its panel, whose RESET puts every station on it back up at once.

The $(item)Outdoor Fire Alarm Pull Box$() stands on its own post, with a red lamp on top, turned to face you as you place it. Run data wire from it to a box. It pulls and resets like the wall station.
The $(item)Panic Button$() goes on a wall, on a floor or under a block, like under a desk. Press it and it stays in while the box sends its alarm; reset it with the key. Wire it like a pull station.

pages.title: Colours
pages.text: For alarms that are not fire there are the $(item)Yellow Alarm Pull Station$() and $(item)White Alarm Pull Station$(), whose bar reads ALERT, and the $(item)Yellow Outdoor Alarm Pull Box$() and $(item)White Outdoor Alarm Pull Box$(). They wire and pull like the red ones; only the colour differs.

pages.title: Alarm types
pages.text: Each location has a kind of alarm, set on its box's programming panel after its name: FIRE, THREAT, DISASTER, MEDICAL, ESCAPE, LOCKDOWN, FLOOD, BREACH or TORNADO. The controller shows and prints it ("ZONE 03 MEDICAL"). Every kind buzzes, rings bells and needs an ack just as a fire does; it is up to you what the bells mean.
